CHEPKOILEL JUNCTION & SINAI, ELDORET

Eldo-City brings the same trusted butchery, grill and lounge experience to Chepkoilel Junction and Sinai. Every cut we sell and every plate we serve comes from meat handled the same day — slaughtered in our own inspected facility, hung clean, and prepared by trained staff. Fresh, honest and consistent, from the display counter to the fire.

THE GRILL

Signature Nyama Choma

Our nyama choma is slow-roasted over an open charcoal fire until the edges char and the centre stays tender. No shortcuts, no heavy marinades — just fire, salt and patience, finished with lemon and served hot off the grill.

Choose goat, beef ribs or kuku choma, all cut from stock in our own butchery that morning. Everything comes with ugali and fresh kachumbari, and larger orders for groups and events can be arranged with a quick call ahead.

THE COUNTER

Butchery

Meat is cut fresh, hung clean and sold the same day. Nothing sits in our display longer than it should, so what you carry home is exactly as fresh as what we put on our own grill.

SINAI BRANCH

Fresh Beef Available

The same quality, hygiene and service — with fresh beef available at our Sinai counter.

FOR FARMERS

Dorper Sheep

We keep and sell quality Dorper sheep — live for farmers building or restocking a flock, or slaughtered to order for functions, family events and bulk meat needs.

Stock and pricing change with the season, so call us for current availability and to arrange viewing or delivery.

UPSTAIRS

VIP Lounge

A private, closed-door section for meetings, quiet conversations and small celebrations. Comfortable seating, controlled entry and a calm atmosphere away from the main floor.

Full service runs straight from the grill and bar, so you never have to leave the room. The lounge fills up quickly on weekends — call ahead to book, especially for groups.
